title: Node
description: One machine: how busy it is, what it waits on, and what runs on it.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Now, per node. Pressure is the share of time tasks waited on CPU, memory or IO, the worst of the three. Click a node for its drill-down.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: CPU on $node now; marks on the rim are warning and critical.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory on $node now; marks on the rim are warning and critical.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Disk on $node now; marks on the rim are warning and critical.

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Pressure on $node now; marks on the rim are warning and critical.

panels.title: CPU by mode
panels.description: Where the CPU time goes. iowait is time stuck on disk; steal is time the hypervisor gave to another tenant.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Used is memory no one can reclaim; page cache gives itself back under pressure.

panels.title: Pressure stalls
panels.description: Share of time at least one task waited. The first sign a node is too small.

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: Reads above the line, writes below.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Physical interface traffic: in above the line, out below.

panels.title: Pods on $node
panels.description: Everything scheduled on this node, busiest first.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""}[5m]) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_info{node="$node"}))
sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_info{node="$node"}))

100 * sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{metrics_path="/metrics/resource",container!=""} * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_info{node="$node"})) / sum by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"})

sum by (namespace, pod) (max_over_time(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{})[1h:1m]) - min_over_time(max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{})[1h:1m])) * on (namespace, pod) group_left () (kube_pod_info{node="$node"})

panels.title: Errors on $node
panels.description: Error-level log lines from every pod on this node, newest first.
